{{Quote|But trust me, it would be better for everyone if you just forgot we ever found this place.''"<br />"''It's too late for that, Ben.|Ben Skywalker, to Vestara Khai, interrupted by the arriving Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
In [[44 ABY]], a '''duel''' took place at the [[Pool of Knowledge]], a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] on [[Abeloth's planet]]. After they [[Mission to the Maw|fought]] and apparently [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Gavar Khai]], and [[Vestara Khai]], along with their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] allies [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], discovered that Abeloth had actually survived. In the ensuing search for her, they were led by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] to the Pool of Knowledge. There, Ben glimpsed the [[Kesh/Legends|Sith homeworld]], and Gavar, suspecting betrayal, moved to attack. Luke [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] Gavar as Taalon glimpsed a [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi queen]] on a [[Throne of Balance|throne]] in the Pool and, fearing that she would prevent the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|rise]] to power, dove in.

Gavar fired [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Luke, but Ben drove him back with [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] before Vestara engaged the younger Jedi in combat. Luke attacked Taalon and Vestara after Taalon reemerged from the Pool, and Gavar threw his [[Parang/Legends|parang]] at Ben, using the Force to guide the blade in between the Jedi's ribs. Gavar then moved to attack Luke, but the Jedi threw him into Taalon and Vestara, and [[Cho sun/Legends|cut off]] Gavar's weapon-[[Limb/Legends|arm]]. After being repelled with Force lightning, Luke fled the grotto with Ben and collapsed the entrance behind them. The Sith then beat Vestara and sent her to the Jedi&mdash;making it appear as though she had fled their punishment&mdash;to find out more about the Jedi [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. Meanwhile, Taalon began to transform into the same type of [[Sentience/Legends|being]] as Abeloth, and the Jedi tracked Abeloth to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], where the Sith again joined them in [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|confronting]] her.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Ship put us down right on ''top'' of the Pool of Knowledge. It wanted to make sure we found the grotto quickly, so we'd all still be relatively close together.''"<br />"''The ambush my father warned about?''"<br />"''In a way. Ship is trying to start a fight between us again&mdash;between your side and ours, I mean.|Ben Skywalker and Vestara Khai|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:Ben_Backlash_front.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Ben Skywalker]]
In [[44 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], embarked on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to confront [[Abeloth]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity who had been causing a [[Force psychosis]] among the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Although the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|betrayed]] the Jedi and attempted to capture Abeloth, Luke defeated and apparently [[Death/Legends|killed]] her.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> The Sith and Jedi repaired their alliance in order to investigate further into Abeloth's nature, under the condition that only [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and Khai's daughter, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], remained on [[Abeloth's planet]] with the Skywalkers.<ref name="Vortex" />

The allies soon discovered that Abeloth had actually survived and began to hunt for her once more. The [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]&mdash;which had originally been called to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by Abeloth herself, although the Sith claimed responsibility for the act&mdash;suggested that they look for her at the [[Pool of Knowledge]], a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] that Luke had seen while [[beyond shadows]] at a [[Sinkhole Station|nearby space station]]. Ship flew them to a location near the Pool and left them to find it themselves. The allies broke up into two groups to search, and Vestara and Ben found the Pool housed in a grotto. Ben realized that Ship had been trying to pit the Jedi and Sith against each other, and he attempted to convince Vestara to leave the grotto, but she had already called the other Sith through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Vortex" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Jedi treachery! I should have killed you days aaah&mdash;''" [Luke Force-pushes him away]<br />"Days ''ago, Gavar, you might have had a chance to succeed.|Gavar Khai and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
In the Pool, Ben saw an image of Abeloth running toward the allies' [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], and he realized that she had used Ship to distract them so that she could escape. Ben insisted that they leave quickly, but Gavar wanted to wait until they were certain. When Vestara and Ben again looked into the Pool, it morphed to show the Tribe's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Tahv]]. Suspecting that the Jedi were trying to betray the Sith and learn of their homeworld, Gavar used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|disperse]] the image and began to threaten Ben. Luke quickly cut him off and Force-pushed the Sith Saber away.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[File:LukeSkywalkerAndGavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker and Gavar Khai]]
Taalon, however, was unconcerned with the outbreak of violence; as he looked into the Pool he saw the [[Throne of Balance]], on which was seated a Jedi [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. He feared the queen might prevent the Sith Tribe's planned takeover of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and thus demanded to know who she was. The Skywalkers recognized the queen as their own relative, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], and chose that moment to attack, knowing that a fight was going to break out regardless. Luke activated his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], while Ben did the same and turned quickly to push past Vestara and attack Taalon. Vestara was shocked at his sudden attack on her and neglected for a moment to counter. Meanwhile, Gavar threw a [[shikkar]]&mdash;a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]]&mdash;at Luke, but the Grand Master dodged the throw and the blade smashed against the stone floor.<ref name="Vortex" />

Ben was able to bypass Vestara, but Taalon had already dived into the Pool. Vestara moved to attack Ben, but he briefly incapacitated her with a kick to her shoulder, which had been injured during the previous fight with Abeloth. Ben prepared to dive in after Taalon, but Luke warned his son off and Force-pushed him away from the Pool. Gavar then blasted Luke with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and Ben retaliated with three shots at the Sith; the bolts were absorbed by Gavar's [[Armor/Legends|armor]], but they knocked him back against the wall. Vestara returned to the fight and attacked Ben, but he was able to draw an opening with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and knock her away. She collided with Taalon as he jumped out of the Pool, and the infuriated High Lord punched the apprentice in retaliation.<ref name="Vortex" />

Luke quickly attacked Taalon and Vestara, and Ben moved to help, but Gavar threw a [[Parang/Legends|parang]] at the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Ben sliced the weapon in two, but the Sith Saber used the Force to jam a shard of the blade straight into Ben's ribs. Gavar then rushed to help Taalon, countering Ben's attempt to shove him away with the Force. Luke, however, grabbed Gavar's ankle and slammed him into the other two Sith before he [[Cho sun/Legends|cut off]] the Sith Saber's weapon-[[Limb/Legends|arm]]. The Sith responded with a torrent of Force lightning that drove the Grand Master back into the grotto wall, until Ben intercepted it with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Luke quickly pushed Ben to the exit and fled the grotto, cutting down one of the outer columns, which resulted in the entire collapse of the entryway.<ref name="Vortex" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I understand your suspicions, Master Skywalker. But this time, I ''do'' intend to kill Abeloth. I have seen what she can do, and I'm no more eager to see her loose in the galaxy than you are.''"<br />"''No. You don't understand what's happening to you, and Abeloth is the only one who knows. She's the only one who can tell you what you're becoming.|Sarasu Taalon and Luke Skywalker on Pydyr|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:VestaraKhai-FOTJPoster.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Vestara Khai]]
The Sith escaped the grotto, and Taalon and Gavar decided to use Vestara as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in order to learn as much as possible about the Jedi queen. Taalon beat her and then ordered her to find the Skywalkers and claim that she had been attacked by the two Sith in punishment but had escaped. While Ben recovered from his injuries, the Jedi returned to the beach and found that their ship, the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', was gone&mdash;Abeloth had already fled in it. Ben went to break into Taalon's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Emiax]]'', but Vestara suddenly arrived on the scene. Taalon and Gavar were not far behind, and Taalon attacked her with Force lightning. Luke laid in hiding and ambushed the Sith with blasterfire, then readied a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. After laying down more covering fire, he rushed to Vestara's aid. He was not fooled by her ploy but decided to allow her to come anyway. Luke's thermal detonator stalled the two Sith and allowed the Jedi to leave with Vestara aboard the ''Emiax''.<ref name="Vortex" />

Gavar and Taalon left the planet in Ship, and the High Lord began to transform into the same kind of being as Abeloth due to his swim in the Pool. Meanwhile, Vestara and the Skywalkers tracked Abeloth to the [[Fallanassi village|home]] of the pacifist [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], where Vestara sent a message to a Sith post on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. The Sith sent reinforcements, including Taalon and Gavar, and again joined the Jedi in [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|confronting]] Abeloth.<ref name="Vortex" />

Further research done by the Sith showed that [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] had many features in common with the Jedi queen seen on the Throne of Balance. The Sith learned that Djo's daughter had died during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]&mdash;although that was in fact a lie spread by Djo to protect the identity of [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], the daughter of Djo and Jedi Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]&mdash;and Gavar, determined to prevent the ascension of the Jedi queen to the throne, decided to plot the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Djo before she could give birth to another child. However, Khai's [[Jedi Queen project|plan]] was unsuccessful.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The duel at the Pool of Knowledge was written by author [[Troy Denning]] for inclusion in his [[2010]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'', the sixth installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
